attributes.note: Thor's Sequence model page publishes a line offer range of $151,060 to $165,060 in its structured data (re-verified October 16, 2026); the low end is the 20L base (the 20L floor plan page publishes the same $151,060 to $161,560 range). Thor's class-B lineup page lists a flat $161,560 MSRP for the Sequence; the disagreement is logged in the conflicts below and the model page figure is displayed, per policy. Floor plan bases: 20L from $151,060, 20U $162,120 to $165,060, 20Y $162,960, each from Thor's own floor plan pages.

Thor rates all three current floor plans (20L, 20U, 20Y) at two. The 20L offers an optional Sky Bunk pop-top (advertised on Thor's 20L page) that adds a bunk; Thor's specification table still rates the 20L at two, and two is the figure displayed.

Basis: Thor's floor plan specification pages list waste water at 4.75 gal on the 20U (a cassette) against 13.5 gal (20L) and 14 gal (20Y) black tanks, and Thor's published standards list both a cassette toilet and a plastic foot-flush toilet as model-specific equipment. Thor's own brochure for the sister Tellaro line, which shares these floor plans, states the same split explicitly (cassette on 20U; gravity toilet on 20L/20Y).
attributes.value: Enclosed wet bath; cassette toilet on the 20U, gravity-flush toilet with black tank on the 20L and 20Y

attributes.note: Per-floor-plan figures from Thor's own specification pages, re-verified October 16, 2026: 20L 22 gal, 20U 27 gal, 20Y 35 gal. Never averaged; see the resolved conflict below.
The 20U's waste capacity as published on Thor's 20U specification page; the 20U is the only current Sequence floor plan with a cassette toilet. The 20L and 20Y use black tanks (13.5 and 14 gal).
Thor's Sequence pages do not publish a fuel capacity; the 24 gal ProMaster tank figure comes from dealer specification tables and is labeled dealer-sourced wherever it appears.
Heat pads appear in Thor's published standards list for the line. The comparison pool rates the Sequence three-season on this basis.
attributes.value: Holding tank heat pads; Truma Combi Eco furnace and water heating; Thor publishes no winter package or insulation rating for the Sequence

chosen.source: Thor Sequence model page structured offer range, corroborated by the 20L floor plan page's published range

conflicts.note: Thor publishes two starting figures for the Sequence: its model page and the 20L floor plan page put the line's low base at $151,060 (20L), while its class-B lineup page lists a flat $161,560 MSRP, which is also the top of the 20L's published range. Logged October 16, 2026.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by policy (Mark, Oct 14, 2026): where the manufacturer's pages disagree, the dedicated model page figure is authoritative for display. The $151,060 figure is displayed and the disagreement stays logged.

chosen.source: Thor 20Y floor plan page (the attribute displays all three floor-plan figures, not a single number)

conflicts.note: Originally logged as a conflict October 14, 2026 (Thor's 20Y page at 35 gal against a dealer listing for a 20U at 27 gal). Re-verified October 16, 2026 against Thor's own pages for all three current floor plans: the figures are floor-plan dependent, not a disagreement (20L 22 gal, 20U 27 gal, 20Y 35 gal). The page displays the per-floor-plan figures with the floor plans named.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved October 16, 2026: floor-plan variance confirmed on the manufacturer's own specification pages; both original values were correct for their floor plans.

name: Sequence
notes: Re-verified October 16, 2026 against Thor Motor Coach's live Sequence pages. Lineup: Thor's current Sequence pages cover three floor plans (20L, 20U, 20Y); legacy plans (20A, 20J, 20K) now redirect to the model overview. Model year updated from 2026 to 2027 to match Thor's current Sequence branding (the overview now presents the 2027 Sequence; the sibling Tellaro ledger already used 2027). Power system, recorded here rather than in the table because Thor's standards list could not be captured from thormotorcoach.com directly: Thor's published standards for the line include a 1,000W inverter, (2) Group 31 house batteries, a 200W solar panel with 30-amp controller, a 2,800W Onan gasoline generator and Truma Combi Eco heat and hot water, with the Re(Li)able Power Pack (400Ah lithium, 3,000W inverter) as the factory lithium option; these are the figures quoted in the page's Solis comparison FAQ, attributed to Thor's standards list. No wet-bath dimensions or model-specific warranty figure are published in the table because none could be verified from a Thor source.
